cmd:
set -e
cd /root/Iryna_Karmazina && git fetch -q origin claude/direct-automation-expeditor-671esy
B=origin/claude/direct-automation-expeditor-671esy
git show $B:direct_sync/maersk_track_sync.py > /root/direct-sync/maersk_track_sync.py
git show $B:direct_sync/maersk-track-sync.service > /etc/systemd/system/maersk-track-sync.service
git show $B:direct_sync/maersk-track-sync.timer   > /etc/systemd/system/maersk-track-sync.timer
systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable --now maersk-track-sync.timer >/dev/null
cd /root/direct-sync && nohup /root/unitex-finrep/.venv/bin/python maersk_track_sync.py > /root/direct-sync/maersk_run2.out 2>&1 &
sleep 95
python3 -c "
for ln in open('/root/direct-sync/maersk_run2.out',encoding='utf-8'):
    if 'Без даних' not in ln: print(ln.rstrip()[:300])"
echo "TIMER_MAERSK: $(systemctl is-enabled maersk-track-sync.timer) next=$(systemctl show -p NextElapseUSecRealtime --value maersk-track-sync.timer)"
